articles.title: Inside Coinbase’s $250 Billion Playbook for Post-Quantum Bitcoin Custody
articles.snippet: Head of cryptography Yehuda Lindell says the exchange is designing custody that can adapt to whatever post-quantum signing scheme Bitcoin adopts.

articles.title: Bitcoin Will Hit $1 Million, Says Kevin O’Leary—But There’s a Quantum Catch
articles.snippet: Kevin O'Leary believes Bitcoin could hit $1 million if crypto beats its quantum computing problem, and explained why he's ditching Ethereum.
